te: Putin discussed with the Security Council the results of negotiations in Abu Dhabi
de: Russian President Vladimir Putin discussed with permanent members of the Security Council the results of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. This was reported by the Kremlin website

t: Путин пообещал проработать получение виз США российскими олимпийцами
d: Президент России Владимир Путин пообещал проработать через МИД возможность получения американских виз российскими олимпийцами и паралимпийцами в Москве. Об этом сообщает «Чемпионат»
te: Putin promised to work on obtaining U.S. visas for Russian Olympians
de: Russian President Vladimir Putin has promised to work through the Foreign Ministry to obtain American visas for Russian Olympians and Paralympians in Moscow. It's reported by "Championship."

t: Сборная США снялась с юношеского ЧМ в Катаре

te: Team USA withdrew from the youth world Cup in Qatar
de: The U.S. Soccer Federation has pulled the country's youth team from the upcoming World Cup for players under 17 in Qatar over safety concerns. This is reported by Match TV with reference to ESPN

te: Belarus beats San Marino in UEFA Nations League
de: The Belarusian national football team defeated San Marino on the road with a score of 2: 0 in the match of the fifth round of the group stage of the UEFA League of Nations. This is reported by euro-football.ru
